projectionOrder: project and sanitize business result or error
wrap the received correlation fields without replacing them

before.description: Run one LOOM operation for the current Thread's Mission: status, plan, release, claim, evidence, submit, inspect, stage-review. `evidence` registers a file you produced (a path relative to the Mission workspace). `submit` sends your claimed task for User acceptance; it never accepts a delivery. The Run, Member and Mission come from Core authentication — you cannot and need not name them.

failure.protocol: throw Error for explicit rejection or indeterminate result
failure.nativeSdkResult: isError:true; code and unknown-outcome recovery text preserved; no retry

unchanged: Bootstrap content, SESSION_CHARTER, MEMBER_IDENTITY and Dynamic Context content/selection/budgets
Tool name, eight operations, Run/bot/Mission authentication, allowed operation keys, workspace guard, claim/acceptance authority
Fixed trusted CLI argv, per-call deterministic request ID, workflow stdin/output budgets, timeout and no-replay boundaries

compatibility.effect: Existing managed extension/source digests also change. A previous native Host/session compatibility identity does not match and must be recreated by the existing lifecycle.
compatibility.migration: No user data or database migration.

validation.workflow: 17/17 offline owners passed with the installed Pi 0.85.1 SDK; the existing Core-contract owner was subsequently extended to load the actual managed-host extension and passed 1/1.
validation.mcp: 21 existing MCP owners passed. The new SDK owner passed its targeted rerun after correcting a test assumption about the maintained client structured-content precedence; production source did not change between these tests.
validation.rust: workflow_tool_sources_agree_on_one_tool_name_and_the_eight_operations passed in the coordinated parent build.
validation.pageScripts: All 29 generated Pi UI expressions parse using the actual page wrapper; one forwarding call is covered.

purpose: Review snapshot of existing Core schemas exposed through the Pi adapter; not a second runtime schema authority.

before.nativeSdkOutcome: A fulfilled handler is marked successful even if its result.isError is true.

after.nativeSdkOutcome: An explicit MCP rejection or sanitized transport failure throws and is marked isError:true.
after.successContent: Unchanged bounded text/image blocks from the maintained client toLlmContent conversion. Existing content takes precedence over structuredContent in that client.
after.errorContent: Already bounded text blocks joined with newline and capped to 65,536 characters; structuredContent uses the same client conversion. SDK emits one text error block. Failure images are omitted; image-only rejection says MCP tool reported an error.
after.retry: None. One handler invocation calls the server at most once.
